Perpetrators

Pet theft for ransom is often carried out by individuals who are motivated by financial gain. In some cases, it may involve organized crime groups who see pets as a lucrative source of income.

Methods

Stealth and Surveillance: The perpetrators often conduct thorough surveillance of the victim's home to identify the best time to execute the theft. They might observe the routines of the household to determine when the pet is left unattended.

Execution: The theft is typically carried out with minimal noise to avoid alerting the household. The perpetrators may use tools to gain entry to the home or exploit unsecured windows or doors.
